## What this region is

Everything a consumer touches before and around the map itself: installing and running atlas on Bun, the CLI shell and its shared flags, the repo-owned configuration (config.ts, kinds.ts, concepts.ts) and the rules that decide which files atlas considers and how it reads them.

## What it exists for

- Running atlas against a repo safely and with the right runtime
- Invoking atlas commands and reading their results
- Configuring atlas for a repo
- Computing from the concept registry
- Starting a .atlas/ folder in a repo
- Listing the files atlas considers or the parsed annotations
- Knowing why a file is in, out, or untouched

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- a stamp rule should fill @partOf from the captured module folder → annotation-blocks
- atlas should treat Tiltfile as a hash-comment file → annotation-blocks
- make CI fail when a file has no atlas block → validation-and-ci
- add the read and grep hooks to the Claude settings → agent-integration
- list every file that is part of the billing feature → map-outputs
